2.name: VIPS
2.summary: Highest spend, most frequent, most recent, happiest customers.
2.strategy: Protect and reward: loyalty perks, early access, personal service. No discounts needed.

3.name: At-Risk Full-Price Buyers
3.summary: Good spenders who have gone quiet and never use discounts.
3.strategy: Win-back campaign: a personal message and new arrivals. Test a small incentive against none.

1.name: Discount-Driven Regulars
1.summary: Regular buyers who always use a discount, with the lowest ratings.
1.strategy: Use bundles, basket minimums and loyalty points instead of blanket discounts.

0.name: Occasional Low-Spenders
0.summary: Rare, small purchases and very low revenue.
0.strategy: Low-cost automated outreach. Aim to increase basket size.
